description: The plot illustrates how AUC performance (in percent) varies with the parameter \(N\) for five different methods/series shown as colored lines with distinct markers. The x-axis is labeled “N” on a linear scale, spanning from 0 to 20 with major tick labels at 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20. The y-axis is labeled “AUC (%)” on a linear scale, ranging from 75 to 100 with tick labels at 75, 80, 85, 90, 95, and 100. A blue solid line with open circle markers starts near 94 at \(N=1\), rises to about 98 at \(N=5\), stays around 98 at \(N=10\), then decreases to about 97 at \(N=15\) and about 94–95 at \(N=20\). A red solid line with open square markers begins around 87 at \(N=1\), increases to about 92–93 at \(N=5\), peaks near 98 at \(N=10\), then declines to about 93–94 at \(N=15\) and about 91–92 at \(N=20\). A green solid line with star markers starts around 86–87 at \(N=1\), increases to about 91 at \(N=5\), to about 92–93 at \(N=10\), reaches about 94–95 at \(N=15\), and then is around 92–93 at \(N=20\). An orange solid line with diamond markers begins near 84 at \(N=1\), rises to about 92–93 at \(N=5\), to about 94–95 at \(N=10\), is about 95 at \(N=15\), and is about 94–95 at \(N=20\). A purple solid line with downward triangle markers starts around 79 at \(N=1\), remains around 79 at \(N=5\), jumps to about 96–97 at \(N=10\), then drops to about 85–86 at \(N=15\) and about 82–83 at \(N=20\).
